entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?
Yes, my name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-682-991.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order for the VeloFit Sprint cycling shoes. To make sure I'm assisting you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's the fit. I've taken them on a few rides, adjusted the cleats, tried different socks... but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. They just aren't working for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear that, Alex. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility on your order. One moment.
Okay, I see the delivery was 49 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

Okay, a full refund is good. I appreciate you approving that. Since I've had this trouble and now I need to find a different product, could you perhaps add a 10% discount code to my account for a future purchase?

I understand your position, and I'm glad we could get the return approved. However, my system is limited to processing the refund as per the policy and doesn't allow for issuing goodwill credits or discounts in this situation. The best I can offer is the full refund we've discussed.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. The refund is the main thing. So, what's the next step?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. Simply print it, attach it to the box with the cycling shoes, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that covers it. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
